page.title: Email Receipts
page.subtitle: Read order confirmations from a mailbox and turn them into itemized transactions: what is connected, what became of each email, and what waits for you

mailbox.heading: Mailbox
mailbox.description: Order confirmations are read from a dedicated mailbox over IMAP. Monize only reads it: it never changes, moves or deletes a message.
mailbox.dedicatedWarning: Use a dedicated mailbox. Every message in the folder is read, so it should hold nothing but order confirmations.
mailbox.encryptionUnavailable: This server cannot encrypt secrets, so a mailbox password or connection cannot be saved. Ask the administrator to set up encryption.

error.title: The mailbox could not be loaded
error.body: The request failed, so nothing is known about your mailbox yet. Try again.

oauth.heading: Connect an account
oauth.explanation: Google and Microsoft 365 usually refuse a plain password. Sign in with the provider instead: you grant Monize access to the mailbox and never type its password here.
oauth.providersUnavailable: Whether Google or Microsoft sign-in is available could not be checked. The manual form below still works.
oauth.badAuthorizationUrl: The server returned a sign-in address that is not a secure web page, so it was not opened.
oauth.notConnected: The connection to {provider} is not active, so the mailbox is not being read. Connect again to resume.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect the mailbox?
disconnectDialog.message: Monize will delete its stored access to {provider} and stop reading the mailbox. Emails already stored are kept.

oauth.revokeNote: Disconnecting does not remove the permission you granted. To withdraw it, remove Monize on the {provider} permissions page.
oauth.saveFailed: Could not save the mailbox settings

form.intro: Or enter the details of any IMAP mailbox. Most providers need an app password rather than your account password.
form.passwordStoredPlaceholder: A password is stored. Type to replace it.
form.passwordRequiredHelp: Required for a new mailbox, or when the server or user name changes.
form.passwordKeepHelp: Leave blank to keep the stored password. It is never shown again.

test.ok: {count, plural, one {The connection works. The folder holds # message.} other {The connection works. The folder holds # messages.}}

settings.folderHelp: The folder to read. It is opened read-only.
settings.enabledHelp: Controls only the automatic reading: when on, Monize reads the mailbox every 15 minutes. Turning it off does not disconnect the mailbox, and Poll now reads it whether this is on or off.
settings.aiModeHelp: Whether the poll may use the AI provider you configured on receipts. Recognize with AI and Prepare a profile with AI ask the assistant in the chat whatever the mode, and an AI answer is always a proposal or a draft that you approve.

aiModeDescriptions.off: The poll never calls the AI for receipts.
aiModeDescriptions.on_demand: The poll never calls the AI. You ask the assistant yourself with Recognize with AI or Prepare a profile with AI.
aiModeDescriptions.automatic: The poll asks the AI about a matched receipt that no approved profile could read completely, and drafts a profile for a sender that has none.

settings.autoApplyHelp: Off by default. A proposal is applied without asking only when all of these hold: an approved profile read the whole email, the transaction was found by an order number or a reference, or by exact amount and payee, with a single candidate, and the proposal adds up to the cent. Everything else waits for your approval.
settings.profileLimitLabel: Count profile proposals toward the daily AI limit
settings.profileLimitHelp: On by default: an edit a profile proposes from an email is counted in the daily limit of AI-proposed changes, like any other AI proposal. Turn it off when a large batch of stored emails would otherwise use the limit up. Only proposals from profiles are exempt; every proposal still waits for your approval.

status.pollResult: Poll finished: {fetched, plural, one {# email saved} other {# emails saved}}, {skipped} skipped, {processed} processed.

deleteDialog.title: Delete the mailbox?
deleteDialog.message: The mailbox settings and every stored email will be deleted, and open review requests from them dismissed. The emails in the mailbox itself are not touched.

parsers.heading: Profiles
parsers.description: A profile reads the order confirmations of one sender with patterns you write or review, and says how the bank transaction is found. Once approved it runs without the AI.

error.title: The profiles could not be loaded

empty.title: No profiles yet
empty.body: Create one for a sender of order confirmations, or draft one from a stored email on the Email Receipts page.

toasts.changedElsewhere: This profile was changed elsewhere. The list has been reloaded.

deleteDialog.title: Delete the profile?
deleteDialog.message: The profile {name} will be deleted. Emails it already read keep their results.

jsonDialog.title: Definition of {name}
jsonDialog.help: The profile definition as it is stored. The matching section shows the settings in effect, defaults included. It is read-only here; use Edit to change it.

processOffer.title: Process the stored emails now?
processOffer.message: {count, plural, one {Process the # stored email} other {Process the # stored emails}} from {domains} now? Each one is read with this profile again; what it proposes waits in the review inbox unless auto-apply is on.

lookupsError.title: Payees and categories could not be loaded
lookupsError.body: The pickers need them, so the editor cannot open yet. Try again.

editor.draftNote: This profile is a draft. It reads nothing until you approve it.
editor.draftAiNote: The AI drafted this profile from your sample emails. Test it against each of them and check every pattern, then approve it from the list. It reads nothing until you do.
editor.domainsHelp: One per line, up to {max}. A sub-domain of a listed domain also matches.
editor.subjectHelp: Optional, one per line, up to {max}. The subject must contain at least one of them, ignoring case.
editor.conflict: This profile was changed elsewhere since you opened it. Reload it to see the current version. Your edits here are not saved.

patterns.sourceHint: Which rendering of the email the patterns below are matched against. Text is the text part of the email, one line per line break. HTML reads the HTML part: every block and every table cell becomes its own line, so a product name that the text splits over several lines stays whole. The email's Lines view shows exactly what each source gives.
patterns.globHelp: Each pattern is matched against one whole line of the email, ignoring case. Use {star} for any text and a name in braces, such as {capture}, to capture a value. Each field takes up to {max} patterns, one per line.
patterns.startAfterHint: Optional. Items are read from the line after the first line containing this text.
patterns.stopAtHint: Optional. Items end before the first line containing this text.
patterns.itemPatternsHint: Must capture {name} and either {amount} (the line total) or {price} (the unit price, optionally with {qty}), never both. Example: {name} x {qty} {price}

categories.heading: Categorias
categories.help: Digite um nome de categoria e selecione-o da lista. O nome é armazenado no perfil e a categoria deve existir quando o perfil é salvo.
categories.defaultHelp: Used for items that get no other category.
categories.shippingHelp: The category of the shipping line.
categories.feesHelp: A categoria da linha de taxas.
categories.unknownCategory: Não há categoria chamada {name}. Escolha uma da lista ou crie-a primeiro.
categories.rulesInJson: Regras de categoria por nome de item são uma opção avançada: adicione-as à definição do perfil no modo JSON.

mode.label: Editing mode
mode.formUnavailable: This definition uses something the form cannot show: labelled entries, multi-line items or keys it has no field for. Edit it as JSON.
mode.jsonInvalid: The JSON is not valid yet, so the form cannot be shown. Fix it first.

json.label: Profile definition (JSON)
json.help: The same definition the form builds. The server checks it when you save, and the test below reads it as it is now.
json.parseError: This is not valid JSON, or it is not a JSON object. Fix it to save or test the profile.

matching.heading: Matching
matching.help: How the bank transaction an email paid for is found. The strategies are tried in order; the first that leaves exactly one transaction decides, several are ambiguous, and none passes to the next.
matching.instruction: O melhor é um número de referência extraído da descrição da operação bancária. Se não houver, a data e o valor são usados. Por padrão, as estratégias são tentadas nesta ordem: referência (quando o perfil tem padrões de referência), número do pedido, valor e beneficiário, valor e data.
matching.referenceHint: The identifier the shop or payment gateway puts into the bank operation, such as a statement text or a transfer title. Must capture {capture}.
matching.strategiesHelp: Order number and reference look for the value in the transaction's description, payee or reference number. Amount and payee needs the amount plus a payee signal. Amount and date needs the amount alone, within the window. At least one must stay on.
matching.referenceNeeded: The reference strategy is on but there are no reference patterns, so it will find nothing.
matching.referenceInLabel: Look for the reference and the order number in
matching.referenceInHint: Values shorter than 4 characters are never looked for.
matching.daysHint: The window around the purchase date. Default {default}, at most {max}.
matching.toleranceHint: How far the bank amount may differ from the email's total. Default 0, at most {max}.

proposal.heading: Proposal
proposal.tagLabel: Add a tag to the transactions this profile categorizes
proposal.tagHelp: The tag is created when you have none by that name. It is shown on the proposal, and nothing is written until you approve it.
proposal.aiCategoriesLabel: Let the AI choose the category of items no rule matches
proposal.aiCategoriesHelp: When an item matches no category rule and there is no default category, the AI is asked for its category from your category list. The choice is marked as the AI's on the proposal. With this off the AI is never asked.

problems.heading: The profile definition is not valid:

fields.label: label
fields.matchReferenceIn: Fields the reference is looked for in

codes.unknown_key: is not something a profile can have
codes.unsupported_version: is a version this server does not read (use version 2)
codes.invalid_type: has the wrong kind of value
codes.malformed_capture: has a capture in braces that is not valid
codes.duplicate_capture: uses the same capture name twice
codes.capture_not_allowed: uses a capture name this field does not accept
codes.capture_missing: is missing a capture this field needs
codes.capture_conflict: captures both the line total and the unit price. Use one of them.
codes.out_of_range: must be a whole number from 1 to {max}
codes.items_patterns_and_record: has both patterns and a record. Use one of them.
codes.items_shape_missing: needs either patterns or a record
codes.skip_lines_need_record: can only be used together with a record
codes.record_name_missing: must capture {capture} in one of its steps
codes.items_single_conflict: has a single item beside patterns or a record. Use one of them.
codes.invalid_value: has a value this field does not accept
codes.reference_field_missing: needs reference patterns (the reference strategy is on)
codes.out_of_range_days: must be a whole number from 0 to {max}
codes.out_of_range_tolerance: must be an amount from 0.00 to {max}

test.heading: Test against a stored email
test.help: Reads a stored email with the patterns above, saved or not, and shows what would be found and which transaction it would match. Nothing is written.
test.loadFailed: The stored emails could not be loaded, so there is nothing to test against yet.
test.noReceipts: No emails are stored yet. Poll the mailbox first.
test.matched: Would link the transaction of {date} for {amount} ({payee}), found by {how}.
test.ambiguous: {count, plural, one {# transaction fits} other {# transactions fit}} equally well, so none would be linked until you choose.
test.unmatched: No transaction matches, out of {count, plural, one {# candidate} other {# candidates}}.
test.jsonInvalid: The JSON is not valid, so there is nothing to test yet.

outcome.not_applicable: This profile would not read this email: none of its required lines is in it, so the next profile for the sender would be tried.
outcome.skip_line: This profile would set this email aside: a line it skips on is in it.
outcome.wait_line: This profile would hold this email: a line says the order is not final, so it is read again later.
outcome.no_html: This profile reads the HTML part of the email, and this email has none, so it would be marked as unreadable (no HTML).

matchedBy.none: No value was read from this email.

trace.window: Transactions from {from} to {to} ({before} days before, {after} days after the purchase): {considered, plural, one {# considered} other {# considered}}.
trace.kept: {count, plural, =0 {kept none} one {kept # transaction} other {kept # transactions}}

reasons.items_unbalanced: The line items do not add up to the total.
reasons.items_uncategorized: Some line items have no category.
reasons.shipping_uncategorized: The shipping line has no category.
reasons.item_amount_missing: An item has no amount, and the email has no single total to give it.

guide.stepSender: Escolha um remetente na nuvem de domínios de remetentes.
guide.stepTransaction: Dê a cada um de seus e-mails a transação que pagou: abra o e-mail e escolha a transação.
guide.stepPrepare: Pressione {button}. O assistente escreve o perfil e você o testa e aprova nos perfis.
